label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) is TP: Random.nextDouble() generates weak pseudo-random numbers used for session token generation, which violates security best practices requiring cryptographically secure random (SecureRandom) for authentication/session management. Alert 2 (XSS) is FP: The sink writes cookie.name and cookie.value to response, but both derive from server-generated values (Random-based rememberMeKey and constructed cookieName), not user input from param.

evidence.note: Weak randomness source (Random.nextDouble()) flows to rememberMeKey
rememberMeKey is server-generated from Random, not user input
XSS sink outputs server-generated cookie values, not user-controlled param
